informal_statement: For r > 0, 0 < theta < pi and positive natural N, the N-edge inscribed polygon gives the Hausdorff lower bound N(2r sin(theta/N)).
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. Arc/segment unions are combined using their proved null overlaps; glued internal chords are not charged as exterior boundary.
